title: [3.0 dev-b] Empty curve after clone profile
body:
When you clone an existing profile, cloned profile is automatically selected in profile plugin to be able to edit or activate it.
But if you open profile plugin, all curves are empty 😢.
You have to select again the profile in upper menu to get all curves

![Screenshot_20220227-100509_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/52934600/155876140-a523182a-f574-4b5a-b803-067c0851a7a8.jpg)

comments.body: I cannot reproduce it with dev-c, so I close Issue
